descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT EFS state 3; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3 · “Generate disabled until Save succeeds (PR #53)”. Mixed: stated part — Row A (summary failed: Generate disabled, says why) and row D (clean: Generate enabled); our part — Rows B (still processing) and C (text edited after processing) and the wording of the reason (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B27 · S2 · new (partly known)

Failure states give the wrong or no guidance: after an interrupted pre-round save the Encounter tab keeps the physician waiting for the panels while the Pre-Round tab says to tap Save Note; an interrupted Nursing Home Save Note says the text was edited; a red 'disconnected' error stays after dictation recovered; a failed Quick Dictation transcription shows only the raw server error, no '⚠ what to do'; with the microphone blocked it still says 'Dictation done — review before saving'; Post-Round shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' forever for a Hospital patient with no note yet

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745/92582): EFS/S06: the Encounter tab does say the panels are still being processed; the fault is that the processing had stopped. TC-04/S28: on a 429 the only thing on screen is the raw server error (B17's kind), and S28 covers only the batch (whisper) path, not a gpt-live failure. EFS/S22: 'Dictation done' with the microphone blocked (UAT state 8). EFS/S02 and TC-20/S24: the endless 'Finalizing…' spinner D7 points to.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-10/S29, TC-23/S08, TC-04/S28, EFS/S17, TC-17/S19

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S06 Generate is blocked exactly when today's pre-round has not been saved cleanly, in both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3a Pre-round summary failed: the raw dictation is kept, an error is shown, and Generate stays disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). (UAT EFS state 3; TFA-94745 state 3; TFA-92588 AC 8 (first sentence))
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given One seeded chart per row: (A) today's pre-round saved but its summary failed (preRoundError set); (B) summary still processing; (C) pre-round text edited after it was last processed; (D) processed cleanly; (E) no pre-round today. Rows A and D also in Nursing Home

When Open each chart's Encounter tab without typing

Then A, B, C: Generate Note & Finish is disabled and the screen says why and to tap Save Note. D: Generate is enabled and no blocking message shows. E: recorded only (Q10)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U3a 'Generate disabled until Save succeeds': rows A and C mustContain 'button "Generate Note & Finish" [disabled]' and 'Save Note'; row D mustContain 'Generate Note & Finish' and mustNotContain the [disabled] form. Row B is judged like A; row E has no expected result (Q10)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92588 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

When the pre-round save was interrupted mid-processing, the Encounter tab greys out Generate without saying why or what to do; the 'Tap Save Note to continue' message appears only on the Pre-Round tab.

Evidence: allure fc7605f3-…-result.json; unit U59 (units/U59.verdict.json), ledger.md #59; s06-hosp-B-processing.md missing "Save Note". Already recorded as dev report §2 #9 (TFA-94745 AC 1/5). Rest tier: the result is 'rest-tier: ticket not ready' because TFA-92588 is at ready for pr, but the defect belongs to TFA-94745 (ready for qa). States A/C/D and NH A/D pass.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
